paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата е озаглавена „Massive Activation of baseline" и илюстрира промените в максималната стойност на активацията за четири различни компонента в зависимост от слоя на модела. Оста X е обозначена като „Layer", има линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23 и етикети, разположени през интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Max Activation Value", също с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до 1600, с етикети през 200 единици.

Първата линия, обозначена като „attn_output", е в син цвят, с пунктиран стил (тире-точка) и без видими маркери. Тя остава близо до нулата от слой 0 до приблизително слой 20, след което рязко нараства и достига стойност около 600 при слой 23.

Втората линия, „attn_residual", е в оранжев цвят с точков (пунктиран) стил. Тя остава близо до нулата от слой 0 до приблизително слой 5, след което рязко нараства до около 1400 при слой 6. Линията се задържа на приблизително 1500 от слой 7 до слой 20, след което рязко спада до около 400 при слой 23.

Третата линия, „ffn_output", е в зелен цвят с тире-точка стил. Тя остава близо до нулата от слой 0 до приблизително слой 4, след което рязко нараства до около 1400 при слой 5. Следва рязък спад обратно до стойности близо до нулата около слой 7. Линията остава ниска до приблизително слой 13, където отново се наблюдава рязък скок до около 500 при слой 14, последван от бърз спад обратно до стойности близо до нулата около слой 16. Тя остава ниска до края на графиката.

Четвъртата линия, „ffn_residual", е в червен цвят с плътен стил. Тя остава близо до нулата от слой 0 до приблизително слой 5, след което рязко нараства до около 1500 при слой 6. Линията се задържа на приблизително 1500–1570 от слой 6 до слой 20, като достига видим връх около 1570 при слоеве 14–15. След слой 20 тя рязко спада до около 400 при слой 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," displays the maximum activation value across different layers of a model for four distinct components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with major tick intervals of 200. The first line, "attn_output," is shown in blue with a dash-dot line style and no visible markers; it remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to roughly 600 by layer 23. The second line, "attn_residual," is depicted in orange with a dotted line style; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to around layer 5, then climbs steeply to approximately 1400 at layer 6, continues rising to about 1500 near layer 8, remains relatively flat around 1500 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 by layer 23. The third line, "ffn_output," is shown in green with a dash-dot line style; it remains near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 4, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back down to near 0 around layer 7, stays near 0 until about layer 13, rises again to roughly 400–500 around layers 13–15, drops back to near 0 around layer 16, remains low through layer 20, and then increases steeply to approximately 600 at layer 23. The fourth line, "ffn_residual," is shown in red with a solid line style; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to around layer 5, rises steeply to approximately 1500 at layer 6, plateaus around 1500–1570 from layer 7 through approximately layer 20, and then drops sharply to around 400 by layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot illustrates the massive activation values of a baseline model across different layers, showing the maximum activation value for four different components of a transformer architecture. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200.

The blue dashed line with no visible markers represents "attn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to roughly 600 by layer 23. The orange dotted line represents "attn_residual," which stays near 0 until around layer 5, where it rises steeply to approximately 1400, then continues to increase gradually to around 1500–1550 through layers 7–20, before dropping sharply to approximately 400 near layer 22 and then rising slightly toward layer 23. The green dash-dot line represents "ffn_output," which remains near 0 until layer 5, where it spikes sharply to approximately 1400, then drops back to near 0 around layer 7, rises again to roughly 400–500 around layers 13–15, returns to near 0 by layer 16, and then increases steeply to approximately 600 at layer 23. The red solid line represents "ffn_residual," which stays near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 5, then rises steeply to approximately 1500 around layer 6, remains relatively flat at approximately 1500–1550 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 near layer 22 before rising slightly toward layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm trägt den Titel „Massive Activation of baseline" und zeigt den maximalen Aktivierungswert über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells für vier verschiedene Komponenten. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Max Activation Value" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis 1600, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 200. Die Linie „attn_output" ist blau, gestrichelt mit Strich-Punkt-Muster und verläuft von Layer 0 bis etwa Layer 20 nahe bei 0, steigt dann ab Layer 21 steil an und erreicht bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 600. Die Linie „attn_residual" ist orange und gepunktet; sie bleibt bis etwa Layer 5 nahe 0, steigt dann steil auf etwa 1400 bei Layer 6 an, verläuft danach relativ konstant bei etwa 1500 bis Layer 20, wo sie abrupt auf etwa 400 bei Layer 23 abfällt. Die Linie „ffn_output" ist grün mit Strich-Punkt-Muster und Dreiecksmarkierungen; sie bleibt bis Layer 4 nahe 0, springt bei Layer 5 auf etwa 1400, fällt dann bei Layer 6 wieder auf nahe 0 zurück, zeigt bei Layer 13 einen erneuten Anstieg auf etwa 500, fällt bei Layer 15 wieder auf nahe 0 und steigt ab Layer 21 steil auf etwa 600 bei Layer 23 an. Die Linie „ffn_residual" ist rot und durchgezogen; sie verläuft bis Layer 4 nahe 0, steigt bei Layer 5 steil auf etwa 1400 an, erreicht bei etwa Layer 7 ein Plateau von ungefähr 1550, hält dieses Niveau bis etwa Layer 20 und fällt dann steil auf etwa 400 bei Layer 23 ab.
